title: Independent Aster autonomous runtime and reporting review
scope: New Aster scheduler, lease fencing, pass ordering, timestamps, truthful status and analytics. Trading financial/protection review is assigned separately to paper_infrastructure. No original desk execution, provider network, broker mutation or app code edits.
confirmed_features: File lock plus SQLite owner/expiry fence protects the operational supervisor; broker submit/cancel are wrapped with an immediate owner check.
Interval failures remain due with bounded backoff; session occurrences have explicit expiry and missed-window records.
Data refresh precedes reconcile then processing; failed books retain independent gates, while configured journal-integrity failure blocks financial processing.
Supervisor/model task creation has no order-originating or funding interface; default books and strategies remain empty.
Analytics counts completed signed-position episodes rather than every partial exit and labels brokerage cashflow coverage as incomplete.

findings.title: Production cycle freezes wall clock before slow data/reconciliation work
findings.evidence: run_once captures UTC once and sends the same datetime after refresh/reconcile and through all jobs/intents. Window expiry, quote age, fills, completion and backoff use that old timestamp.

minimal_reproduction.environment: Temporary SQLite only, real Store and TradingDesk, fake calendar/provider, no network or sleeps
steps: Fund local main100; ingest manual AAPL10 at t.
Submit explicit GTC buy1 with expiry t+5seconds.
Patch production autonomy.utc_clock(None) to fake current. Fake provider refresh advances fake current from t to t+30seconds.
minimal_reproduction.expected: No fill after expiry; intent expired at fresh execution-time UTC.

findings.impact: Late auction/explicit-expiry execution and stale/future quote classification; retries and successes can be stamped before completion.
findings.fix: Preserve explicit injected test clock; recompute production wall clock before each job/window/financial processing and after potentially slow broker reads before submit. Record actual completion and retry time.
findings.status: Fixed by runtime and trading owners; independently retested with zero late fills

findings.title: Refresh universe retained terminal instructions and zero positions without active coverage priority
findings.evidence: Initial SQL selected every distinct symbol from intents/positions without status/quantity predicate and globally rotated all names.
findings.impact: Historical symbols consumed limited feed capacity while active holdings/protection lacked priority.
findings.fix: Owner now filters terminal/zeroqty, prioritizes held/protective symbols then active instructions, rotates remaining observations and exposes overcapacity/deferred active symbols.
findings.status: Fixed; independently tested90terminalintents and21heldsymbol rotation/capacity evidence
findings.confidence: confirmed initial source and isolated fix verification
